FWFS-E01-P02-A-L001 Hall ke entrance par floral arch ab theek jagah tha. Ankita ne phone par revised layout bheja hi tha ki registration desk se kisi ne kaha, 'QR scan ho raha hai, lekin list mein naam doosri baar aa raha hai.' Usne sirf ek nazar tablet par daali. Yeh decoration ka issue nahi tha; guest ke liye yahi pehla real interaction hota.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L002 Counter sambhaal rahe event-tech vendor ne apna introduction diya: Nikhil Sethi, thirty-five, wedding ke digital check-in system ka on-site specialist. Usne screen Ankita ki taraf ki. Guest-list sync ko lekar vendor aur volunteer pichhle das minute se ek-doosre ko blame kar rahe the.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L003 Nikhil: Data duplicate ho raha hai. Back-end list mein entry ek hi hai, lekin volunteer refresh kare toh check-in waapas pending aa jaata hai.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L004 Ankita: Ek baar mujhe guest ban kar try karne dijiye. Aap mujhe instructions mat dijiye.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L005 Nikhil screen se hat gaya. Ankita ne ek loose curl kaan ke peeche kiya aur tablet uthaya. Koi dramatic entry nahi thi, phir bhi uske calm andaaz ne bheed mein Nikhil ka dhyaan khinch liya. Ek pal ko usne screen ke bajay uski concentrated aankhen dekhi, phir khud ko kaam yaad dilaya.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L006 Ankita: Technical bug baad mein fix kar lenge. Abhi problem yeh hai ki user ko success dikh nahi rahi. Volunteer ko lagta hai button nahi chala, woh dobara tap karta hai.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L007 Nikhil: Toh success state screen par hold karni hogi. Aur button ko temporarily disable?
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L008 Ankita: Exactly. Phir ek visible 'Next Guest'. Aur internet gaya toh paper backup—kal koi queue mein khada nahi rehna chahiye.
FWFS-E01-P02-A-L009 Volunteer ne wahi flow repeat kiya. Is baar Nikhil ne temporary setting adjust ki, aur Ankita ne aakhri confirmation khud check ki. System production-ready nahi tha, lekin usko test karne aur guest ko properly guide karne ka plan ab clear tha.

FWFS-E01-P02-A-L030 Screen par pehle Karan Malhotra aaye, thirty-six, client-side Product Manager. Confident tone aur chhoti, friendly jokes unki habit thi. Dusri window mein Aman Joshi, thirty, front-end developer, comparatively quiet tha; woh screen share aur implementation notes dekh raha tha.
